sections.title: Executive Summary + Investment Thesis
sections.body:
**Executive Summary**
Nestle India Limited (NESTLEIND) reported a total income of ₹202,604.2 million for the financial year ended 31st March 2025, with a profit after tax of ₹33,145.0 million. The company's revenue from operations net of GST was ₹200,775.0 million, while other operating revenues and other income contributed ₹1,240.6 million and ₹588.6 million, respectively. The company's profit before exceptional items and tax was ₹41,566.5 million, with an exceptional item expense of ₹2,908.2 million. As of 31st March 2025, the company's retained earnings stood at ₹40,089.5 million.

**Investment Thesis**
Our investment thesis for NESTLEIND is based on its stable financial performance and strong brand presence in the Indian market. With a profit from operations of ₹43,104.1 million and an earnings per share of ₹34.38, the company has demonstrated its ability to generate consistent profits. Additionally, the company's investment in associate company, Dr. Reddy's and Nestlé Health Science Limited, with a carrying amount of ₹5,750.3 million as of 31st March 2025, provides a potential growth avenue. However, a detailed peer comparison is not possible due to the lack of available data. Overall, we believe that NESTLEIND's strong brand portfolio, stable financials, and growth initiatives position it well for long-term growth and make it an attractive investment opportunity.

sections.title: Management Commentary
sections.body:
The management of Nestlé India Limited has provided commentary on the tax expense for the year ended 31st March, 2025. The total tax expense for the year comprises of current tax and deferred tax, amounting to ₹10,817.4 million. The current income tax charge is calculated based on the tax laws enacted or substantively enacted at the end of the reporting period. The management has also evaluated positions taken in the tax returns with respect to situations where applicable tax regulations are subject to interpretation or under dispute with authorities, and has established provisions where appropriate. The provision for current tax for the period includes estimated tax expense accrued on the profit for the period from 1st April 2024 to 31st March 2025, as well as the residual tax expense for the period from 1st April 2023 to 31st March 2024.

The management has also noted that deferred taxes are recognised on a balance sheet approach, based on temporary differences between the carrying amount of assets and liabilities and their corresponding tax base. Deferred tax assets are recognised only to the extent that it is probable that future taxable profits will be available against which such assets can be utilised. The total deferred tax expense for the year is ₹171.1 million, which is significantly lower than the previous year's amount of ₹376.5 million. However, without additional information on the company's net profit or net worth, it is difficult to assess the impact of the tax expense on the company's overall financial performance. sections.title: Key Risks
sections.body:
The 'Key Risks' section of this report highlights potential challenges that NESTLÉ INDIA LIMITED (NESTLEIND) may face. One key risk is associated with the company's investment in its associate company, Dr. Reddy's and Nestlé Health Science Limited, which was made on 24th July 2024. As of 31st March 2025, the carrying amount of this investment was ₹57.50 billion (5,750.3 million). The associate company's financial performance, with revenue of ₹2.15 billion (2,148.8 million) and profit of ₹1.61 billion (1,607.9 million) for the financial year ended 31st March 2025, may have a significant impact on NESTLEIND's consolidated financials. Any adverse changes in the associate company's performance could negatively affect NESTLEIND's financial position.

Another risk arises from the consolidation adjustments related to the investment in the associate company. As of 31st March 2025, the consolidation adjustments stood at ₹1.89 billion (1,886.0 million), which is a significant amount. Any changes in these adjustments could impact the carrying amount of the investment in the associate company, potentially affecting NESTLEIND's net worth and profitability. However, without more detailed information on the company's operations and industry trends, it is challenging to assess the likelihood and potential impact of these risks. Peer comparison is also not possible due to the lack of available data.

sections.title: Recent Developments
sections.body:
The recent developments at NESTLEIND indicate a notable shift in the company's dividend payout policy. For the financial year ended 31st March 2025, the Board of Directors has recommended a final dividend of ₹10.00 per equity share, amounting to ₹9,641.6 million. Additionally, the company has paid an interim dividend of ₹17.00 per share for the financial year 2024-25. It is worth noting that the company's equity shares underwent a sub-division, where one equity share with a face value of ₹10 was sub-divided into 10 equity shares with a face value of ₹1 each, effective from the record date of 5th January 2024.

In terms of geographical revenue, the company generated ₹192,926.7 million in revenue from external customers in India for the financial year ended 31st March 2025, while revenue from outside India stood at ₹7,848.3 million. The company's total income for the financial year ended 31st March 2025 was ₹202,604.2 million, comprising sale of products, other operating revenues, and other income. The profit after tax for the financial year ended 31st March 2025 was ₹33,145.0 million, with an earnings per share of ₹34.38. sections.title: Bull vs Bear vs Base Case
sections.body:
The bull case for NESTLEIND is supported by the company's recent investment in Associate Company, Dr. Reddy's and Nestlé Health Science Limited, with a 49% ownership interest and a carrying amount of ₹5,750.3 million as of 31st March 2025. The associate company's financial performance, with revenue of ₹2,148.8 million and profit of ₹1,607.9 million for the financial year ended 31st March 2025, also presents a positive outlook. This investment could potentially drive future growth and profitability for NESTLEIND.

The bear case, on the other hand, is limited by the lack of comparable information for the associate company, as the investment was made on 24th July 2024. This lack of historical data makes it challenging to assess the associate company's long-term financial performance and potential risks. Additionally, the consolidation adjustments of ₹1,886.0 million, which contributed to the carrying amount of the investment, may pose integration risks. Our base case assumes that NESTLEIND will continue to benefit from its diversified portfolio and the associate company's financial performance, with the investment contributing to the company's growth prospects. However, without peer comparison data, it is difficult to assess NESTLEIND's relative performance. Overall, our base case estimates are based on the available financial information, and we will continue to monitor the company's progress and update our estimates as more information becomes available.
